You must turn on Auto Scaling *instance scale-in protection* on the Auto Scaling group to use the managed termination protection feature of cluster auto scaling.

qualifiers.scope: Amazon ECS Auto Scaling group capacity providers

evidence.quote: A `targetCapacity` value of less than 100% represents the amount of free capacity (Amazon EC2 instances) that need to be present in the cluster.
You can set the `targetCapacity` percentage so that you have spare capacity. This helps future tasks launch more quickly because the Auto Scaling group does not have to launch more instances.

claim: When the CapacityProviderReservation value is greater than the targetCapacity the Auto Scaling group launches EC2 instances and registers them with the cluster, and when the value is less than the targetCapacity it terminates instances that can be removed and deregisters them from the cluster.
